title: On Skipping over the widest drain
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：skip　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 skip 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the nurse ① skipped over the widest drain at once, and every sufferer in the ward said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the nurse ② skips over the widest drain in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ skip over the widest drain at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ skipped over the widest drain before — a line in the report for April 1945 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Skipping over the widest drain at once, the nurse said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ skip two whole pages of the report in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Skip two whole pages of the report at once and never mention it again.

By 1958 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new sufferer from the next ward ⑧ skips two whole pages of the report at once every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cupboard, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ skipped over the widest drain again when nobody else would.

⑩ To skip over the widest drain, my mother said in 1963, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the ward remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the ward forgets, somebody skips over the widest drain in the rain again and somebody must skip over the widest drain at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 跳过（一般过去式 skipped over the widest drain：1951 年护士头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 跳过（一般现在 skips over the widest drain：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 跳过（不定式 to skip over the widest drain：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 跳过（过去完成时 had skipped over the widest drain：1945 年四月的护理记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 跳过（动名词 skipping over the widest drain 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 略过（skip two whole pages of the report：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去略过把报告整整跳过了两页）
G. v. 略过（skip two whole pages of the report：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 跳过（后段两处：新来的病患照例 skips two whole pages of the report，而母亲又一次 skipped over the widest drain）

answers.why: skip 意为“跳过”，1951 年护士二话不说地跳过跃过最宽的那条排水沟，那是病房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 skipped。
skip 意为“跳过”，自那以后护士淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 skips。
skip 意为“跳过”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯跳过跃过最宽的那条排水沟”，此处为不定式 to skip over the widest drain。
skip 意为“跳过”，护理记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1958 年之前就有人跳过过，故用过去完成时 had skipped。
skip 意为“跳过”，护士说“跳过跃过最宽的那条排水沟这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 skipping over the widest drain 作主语。
skip 意为“略过”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去略过把报告整整跳过了两页”，should ever 之后用原形 skip two whole pages of the report。
skip 意为“略过”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻略过把报告整整跳过了两页（skip two whole pages of the report at once），以后再也不要提起。
skip 意为“跳过”，新来的病患每个夜晚都照例略过把报告整整跳过了两页，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 skips。
skip 意为“跳过”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地跳过跃过最宽的那条排水沟，用一般过去式 skipped 叙述。
skip 意为“跳过”，结尾那句是母亲 1963 年的话：要跳过跃过最宽的那条排水沟，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和病房记住的那一件。

answers: In 1951 the nurse skipped over the widest drain at once, and nobody in the ward forgot it.
Even now the nurse skips over the widest drain in the rain whenever the ward asks.
